record.body:
## Problem

`mypy orchestra --ignore-missing-imports` reports 41 errors in 12 files. A blocking types job cannot pass until they are gone.

## Approach

Add a `[tool.mypy]` config with a fixed scope and a pinned mypy version. Fix the 41 errors. Make the `types` job blocking. Decide at plan-phase.

## Exit criteria

- The pinned mypy command reports 0 errors on the configured scope (command).
- The `types` job is blocking and passes on a pull request (observed GitHub Actions run).

payload.title: Fix mypy errors and make the types job blocking

record.subject: mypy-gate
